metadata.description:
#マリオカートツアー

実際のWRはもう少し速いですが、動画撮れなかったためこちらをアップロード。

decision: Preserve as a distinct title-described 1:30.62 recording, not proof of the announced 1:30.47. Description explicitly says the actual WR was faster and could not be recorded. Exact original submission and achievement clocks unknown.
limitations: Sampled result image output was omitted by the image gateway; no fresh pixel or start-to-finish race verification claimed.
December17 announcement assigns Animal Tour but does not establish the exact November achievement clock.
